description: Find a phone number in the Calmido directory (Netherlands, Belgium, Luxembourg). The query is a phone number, international (+31 20 123 4567) or national (020 123 4567); it is not a name or free text. Returns the matching directory entry, if any. Pass its id to `fetch` for the verdict and reports.
